# Platform export notes

Checked **2026-10-04**. Export dimensions are pixels. A requested export is not necessarily a platform minimum.
All four profile variants use a centred mark, 68% of the square width. Its bounding-box corners fit within radius 39.5% of the square, giving generous room inside a circular crop. Files themselves are square and have no frame.

| Platform | Included profile | Guidance checked |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Instagram | 320 × 320 | [Hootsuite](https://blog.hootsuite.com/social-media-image-sizes-guide/#Instagram_image_sizes) recommends 320 × 320. |
| LinkedIn | 400 × 400 | [LinkedIn Page specifications](https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a563309/image-specifications-for-your-linkedin-pages-and-career-pages) recommend a 400 × 400 company logo; the minimum is 268 × 268. |
| YouTube | 800 × 800 | [Hootsuite](https://blog.hootsuite.com/social-media-image-sizes-guide/#YouTube_image_sizes) recommends 800 × 800; [YouTube](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/12950272) recommends square or round artwork. |
| X | 400 × 400 | [X Help](https://help.x.com/en/managing-your-account/how-to-customize-your-profile) recommends 400 × 400. |
| Facebook | 720 × 720 | Brief-selected high-resolution export; [Hootsuite](https://blog.hootsuite.com/social-media-image-sizes-guide/#Facebook_image_sizes) recommends 320 × 320 in its detailed profile section. Its summary table instead lists 196 × 196 (display size). |
| TikTok | 200 × 200 | [Hootsuite](https://blog.hootsuite.com/social-media-image-sizes-guide/#TikTok_image_sizes) recommends 200 × 200 and notes a 20 × 20 minimum. |

Each family also includes a 1080 × 1080 master. Instagram, Facebook and TikTok values above use secondary guidance; they are not presented as independently verified official upload requirements.

## How cropping is handled

Only decorative shapes reach the edges. Logo placement is calculated from an undistorted 510:300 mark and checked against each content-safe rectangle in `source/asset-manifest.json`.
LinkedIn and X logos sit right of conservative lower-left avatar envelopes. Facebook logos sit near the upper centre-right, clear of lower-left and lower-centre profile overlaps. The Facebook content box is narrower than the projected central 16:9 mobile crop; no assumption that desktop and mobile show identical pixels is needed.
YouTube’s mark is centred in the all-device strip. Outer shapes are decorative on TV and may disappear on mobile.

**Preview overlays are design guides, not screenshots of the platform UI.** Except for the brief’s YouTube zone and X’s published crop warning, these safe rectangles and avatar envelopes are conservative kit decisions. Crop/placement may vary with screen, account type, or interface changes; inspect the platform upload preview without moving the artwork off centre.
The cover files contain no overlay labels and no text. Background-only files omit the mark entirely.

## Colour and icon references

- [WCAG contrast and relative luminance](https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/contrast-minimum.html): sRGB conversion and contrast thresholds used in the swatch table.
- [Web Application Manifest icon masks](https://www.w3.org/TR/appmanifest/#icon-masks): safe circle radius is 40% of the icon size. The maskable export’s entire mark fits within it on opaque white.
